ValidationRule.description: User cannot change the field BD/CS SOS to To Transfer to CS when the oppty is on Qualification stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( ISPICKVAL ( BD_CS_SOS__c, 'To Transfer to CS'), ISPICKVAL (StageName, 'Qualification'), OR ( ISCHANGED (StageName), ISCHANGED (BD_CS_SOS__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: BD/CS SOS is not allowed to be "To Transfer to CS' while the stage is Qualification stage. Please update the BD/CS SOS if the Opportunity stage is still on Qualification stage.
